question: EGLU is related to IKOX in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, UWXG is related to YAAJ. To which of the given options is GIGP related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, EGLU is related to IKOX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/514ab5b57894a5071adc16e3991dac0bdf08a4a63487725013ad44daa5e77189.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8377d671aeb0ac7000dc51a64d551053854f2eb51b27cf1a51e13e566d34f6a.png] 

For, UWXG is related to YAAJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5485e22e114233a27daf33aaf4b793317a577a84d1af834edba92d2a612029ec.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3574d790a89378b3333260a1b0500047d6880572da9cbc13f63e6a960595a3a8.png] 

Similarly, for 'GIGP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f32053e93c17efc73d495b1d648d4665d0f7dc56b4a59693b32400692d9290ce.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3c86e4108e3b55dc01d4372a34c0964b4cde223a5447af488e5c2fc2ec9ba18.png] 

So, **'GIGP'** will be related to **'KMJS'**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
